description: The MIDI control window's access. It is a view of the main window's state: the relay pair below is every app command it may invoke, so it has no device, file, dialog, updater or process access of its own — enforced now rather than described. Of the core permissions it holds only the devtools hotkey a development build injects into every webview, a command a release build does not contain: none that emits or listens for an event, so a script in it cannot raise an event the main window listens for.
